senses.gloss:
लट् 2. लट्, a technical term or symbol
in grammar for the terminations of the Present or
for that tense itself.
—लड्-अर्थ-वाद, अस्, m., N.
of a treatise on the meaning of the Present tense.

लट, अस्, m. one who speaks like a child, a block-
head, fool; a fault, defect; a thief.
—लट-पर्ण,
अम्, n. = त्वच, large cinnamon.

लाट लाट, आस्, m. pl. (according to some
formed fr. राष्ट्र), N. of a people and of the
district inhabited by them (= Λαρικη of Ptolemy);
(अस्), m. a king of the Lāṭas; clothes, dress; old or
worn-out clothes, shabby ornaments, &c.; idle or
childish language; repetition of words in the same
sense but in a different application; (अस्, ई, अम्),
relating to the Lāṭas, of or belonging to Lāṭa; old,
worn, spoiled, &c.
—लाटाचार्य (˚ट-आच्˚), अस्, m.
the teacher of the Lāṭas, N. of an astronomer.
—ला-
टानुप्रास (˚ट-अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘Lāṭa-repetition,’ the
repetition of a word in the same sense but with a
different application, (see लाटक.)
लटक, अस्, m. a bad man, contemptible person.

लाटक, अस्, इका, अम्, of or belonging to the
Lāṭas, customary among them; (इका), f. a particular
style of speech or composition, (see रीति.)
लट्य, Nom. P. लट्यति, &c., to speak foolishly.
लाट्य लाट्य, Nom. P. लाट्यति, &c., to live.

लट्व, अस्, m. a horse; a particular caste (said to
be a tribe of mountaineers); a dancing boy; a par-
ticular Rāga or scale in music; (आ), f. a kind of
bird (said to be a kind of sparrow); safflower; a
kind of Karañja; the fruit of a kind of Karañja;
fruit in general; a curl on the forehead, &c. (=
भ्रमरक); a game, gambling (= द्यूत); a
bad or unchaste woman; a sweetmeat (?) ; = अवद्य;
= शिली.
लट्वाका, f. = लट्वा, a kind of bird.

लटकन लटकन or लटकन-मिश्र, अस्,
m. a proper N.

लाट्यायन लाट्यायन, अस्, m., N. of the
author of a Sūtra work.
